sections.title: WORKOUT
lines: How To Break Up With Added Sugar (Part 3 of 3)

Much of the damage sugar does to your body can be reversed, and the first step is finding out where you stand. In Part 3 of our series on sugar, learn the signs you may be eating too much, from afternoon crashes and constant cravings to cavities, acne, and skin changes. Find out what happens when you cut added sugar, how to improve blood sugar naturally, and whether artificial sweeteners deserve a spot in your pantry. Then stop asking how much sugar you can get away with and start asking what your body needs to thrive.

lines: 3 Deadlifts to Knee (Focus on driving the bar away from the floor)

sections.title: Loading Notes:
lines: • Percentages are off the 1RM Deadlift; overall effort stays below RPE 7 today.
• The goal is quality touches on the deadlift, not a heavy day, so do not build past the written percentages.
• Reset the brace between reps, touch and go only if the setup stays identical rep to rep.
• Setup: Shoulders over the bar, lats engaged, midline braced before the pull.
• Pull: Push the floor away, bar tracks close to the legs, hips and shoulders rise together.
• Finish: Stand to full extension with the glutes, control the bar back to the floor.

sections.title: Modifications:
lines: • Level 1: Moderate load by feel across the same rep scheme or Trap Bar Deadlifts or Sumo Deadlifts, even Deadlifts off blocks could be a good way to go.
• Hotel Gym / Travel: Dual Dumbbell Deadlifts or Kettlebell Deadlifts at a moderate load for the same reps.

sections.title: FIGHT GONE BAD
lines: How do you perform the “Fight Gone Bad” workout?

Perform 1 minute of work at each of the 5 stations. Move immediately to the next station after 1 minute. The clock does not reset or stop between exercises. One-minute break is allowed before repeating each round. One point is given for each rep, except on the rower where each calorie is one point.
How do you score the “Fight Gone Bad” workout?
*Score is the total cumulative number of repetitions completed of all movements in all 3 rounds.*
